title: ATTUNE: Agentic Throughput Tuning for LLM Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.17528v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The throughput of an LLM training job depends on its recipe: how the model is split across GPUs, how memory is traded for compute, and which kernels and communication overlaps it uses. The best recipe changes with every model, accelerator and framework version. Automated tuners search a fixed space of knobs and check only that a job runs, so they miss levers outside that space and can ship a configuration that silently changes training. ATTUNE is a coding agent that tunes any working recipe unattended within a GPU-hour budget. Guided by a skill of search rules, scripts and lessons from past tuning campaigns, it diagnoses each run and changes one lever at a time. A correctness gate outside the agent refuses any argument known to change the training objective. translated_title: ATTUNE：面向LLM训练的智能体化吞吐量调优
translated_abstract: LLM训练任务的吞吐量取决于其配置方案：模型如何在GPU之间切分、如何以内存换取计算、使用哪些内核以及采用何种通信重叠策略。最佳配置方案会随每个模型、加速器和框架版本而变化。自动调优器只能搜索固定的参数空间，且仅检查任务能否运行，因此会遗漏该空间之外的调节手段，还可能给出一个悄然改变训练行为的配置。ATTUNE是一个编码智能体，能够在GPU小时预算内无人值守地调优任何可正常运行的配置方案。它由一套包含搜索规则、脚本和以往调优经验的技能库指引，对每次运行进行诊断并一次只调整一个参数。智能体之外的正确性门控会拒绝任何已知会改变训练目标的参数设置。ATTUNE在H100、H200和B200集群上调优了亚马逊的生产级后训练配置方案，平均将吞吐量提升1.7倍。它超越了四款（原文在此处截断）已公布的吞吐量。
tldr: ATTUNE是一个无人值守的编码智能体，通过“一次调一个参数”的诊断式搜索和正确性门控，在GPU小时预算内将LLM训练吞吐量平均提升1.7倍，同时确保不改变训练目标。
en_tdlr: ATTUNE is an unattended coding agent that tunes LLM training recipes one lever at a time with an external correctness gate, boosting throughput by 1.7x on average within a GPU-hour budget without altering the training objective.
